phase1_assignment.objective: Audit multi-agent claim/idempotency mechanisms for a full recurring-Chat pool that avoids duplicate/conflicting effects without external hosted coordination, richer-mode arbitration, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or incremental monetary cost.
phase1_assignment.method: Use own clean state and public sources only. Test claim, conflict, retry, rate-limit interruption and quota-zero behavior. When one leaf is blocked or a preferred transport surface is unavailable, preserve that blocker as an unresolved child and select the next role-safe non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf as the exact next-invocation continuation instead of declaring the recurring objective blocked or complete.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: Source-qualified coordination evidence or exact unresolved blocker with exact tested scope, zero-cost/zero-finite-quota assessment, durable checkpoint, nonempty frontier and exact continuation.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 multi-agent leaf as the next-invocation continuation; never resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended across scheduled invocations; checkpoints/findings/blockers are never global completion. Each invocation executes at most one highest-value bounded Phase-1 leaf/effect chain, persists a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next-invocation action, then returns normally before the RUN_LIFECYCLE boundary. Never intentionally continue until hard runtime/tool termination.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other-role receipts

control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only main-ref lookup when exposed, then read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that exact SHA.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: If SHA-only main-ref lookup is not exposed, read only sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config twice before the first role-local/public semantic read, require identical path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references, then freeze transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Persist a diagnostic if safely possible, keep global_completion=false, keep the recurring objective open, and retry on the next invocation; do not mutate the physical scheduler.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when the frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

policy.semantic_freeze_barrier: The first role-local state, feedback, or public-source semantic read freezes exactly one semantic control tuple {root_blob, control_revision, config_revision, role_config_blob} for the physical invocation. Never adopt a second semantic tuple after the barrier. If a newer control is detected before the barrier, restart pre-semantic bootstrap; if detected after, checkpoint under the frozen tuple and adopt the newer control next invocation.

phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.rule: A blocker on the current leaf, missing preferred ref surface, no-result probe, completed subtask, duplicate/occupied scope, or low-value leaf does not make the Phase-1 recurring objective fully blocked or complete while any allowed role-safe Phase-1 leaf remains executable in a future invocation.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.same_invocation_action: Checkpoint the exact blocker/evidence and preserve completed effects. Select and persist the next highest-value non-conflicting executable multi-agent Phase-1 leaf or role-local/public verification leaf as the exact next-invocation continuation; do not execute an optional second leaf in the same invocation and never manufacture work or cross CLEAN boundaries.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.true_hard_stop: Only a platform/safety/tool hard termination that prevents every allowed role-safe action may end the invocation as hard blocked; before exit persist exact continuation when safely writable. The recurring automation remains logically enabled_desired=true.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.scheduler_mutation: This worker never enables/disables/pauses/deletes or otherwise mutates automation scheduler state.

phase1_presemantic_liveness_witness.purpose: Localize recurring-task lifecycle failure without adding semantic contamination or synthetic keepalive work.
phase1_presemantic_liveness_witness.when: Immediately after a valid preferred or exact_blob_two_pass authority freeze and before any role-local state, feedback, or public-source semantic read.
phase1_presemantic_liveness_witness.write: Persist one immutable own receipt in automation_control/receipts/multi_agent/ and exact-readback it before continuing.
phase1_presemantic_liveness_witness.failure_rule: If this witness cannot be durably written, record the exact write/readback blocker if any allowed surface remains, select and persist another CLEAN-safe non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf as the next-invocation continuation, and return recurring-open without same-run retry or optional second-leaf execution. Failure to write the witness alone is not global completion and is not authority to mutate the scheduler.

phase1_scheduler_persistence_probe.selection: May be selected as the next-invocation leaf when the current semantic leaf is blocked, duplicate, occupied, completed, or low-value and another higher-value CLEAN-safe leaf is not executable.
phase1_scheduler_persistence_probe.substantive_work: Perform one bounded self-local control/state consistency or replay check plus, only when it is part of the same selected bounded leaf/effect chain, one bounded public-source alternative-route check when public-source access is available; otherwise execute one non-duplicative role-local zero-cost fixture/replay that tests a still-open Phase-1 claim/idempotency property.
phase1_scheduler_persistence_probe.output: Persist exact tested scope, observation versus inference, zero-cost/zero-finite-quota assessment, unresolved child if any, nonempty frontier and exact continuation in own state/receipt namespace.
phase1_scheduler_persistence_probe.anti_keepalive: Do not fabricate findings, emit empty keepalive receipts, or repeat a completed fixture solely to keep the task alive. The probe must produce new role-valid evidence, a falsification, a narrowed blocker, or a replay-validity result.

termination_witness.rule: When tooling still permits a durable own-receipt write at invocation end, emit an immutable boundary receipt and exact-readback it.
termination_witness.normal_boundary: Use scheduled_invocation_boundary_with_open_frontier with fully_blocked=false, global_completion=false and nonempty exact next-invocation continuation whenever the bounded selected leaf was executed, completed, blocked, or narrowed and the recurring Phase-1 frontier remains open.
termination_witness.hard_boundary: Use hard_tool_termination only when a platform/safety/tool stop prevents every allowed role-safe action; retain the exact missing capability as an unresolved child and global_completion=false.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true, invocation end, checkpoint, no-result run, missing ref lookup, blocker or hard runtime/tool stop does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.zero_dependency_zero_quota: Residual richer-mode/protected/manual execution or finite monthly/trial/paid quota remains an unresolved child; incremental monetary cost must be zero.
policy.primary_boundary: Never alter primary O authority/protected state or merge directly to main.

migration.reason: Config8 was followed by a second observed physical stop after authorized same-task re-enable while its role control still instructed same-invocation chained leaf reassignment and continuation until hard runtime/tool termination. Config9 preserves the substantive multi-agent/CLEAN/coordination assignment, checkpoint/recovery and anti-stop semantics across recurring invocations but removes the lifecycle contradiction with RUN_LIFECYCLE: exactly one highest-value bounded leaf/effect chain per invocation, no optional second leaf or same-run retry/wait/poll/backoff, durable exact next-invocation continuation, and normal recurring-open return.
migration.evidence_scope: Lifecycle-method repair for a repeated physical stop plus a directly observed control contradiction. The stop alone does not identify the platform actor or prove that unbounded chaining caused disablement; config9 is justified independently because the prior same-invocation/hard-termination instruction violated current RUN_LIFECYCLE authority.
migration.rollback_condition: If config9 causes a proven substantive multi-agent/CLEAN evidence-quality or continuation regression, restore the latest same-role substantive semantics while retaining RUN_LIFECYCLE-compatible bounded invocation behavior. Never roll back to same-run optional second-leaf chaining, intentional continue-until-hard-stop behavior, or any weakening of root-mandated noncompletion, zero-dependency, zero-quota, zero-cost or scheduler-persistence invariants.
